name: metar-to-iwxxm-workflow
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y gh) || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y gh); fi; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi; export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; cd /workspaces/metar-to-IWXXM; [ -f .env.example ] && [ ! -f .env ] && cp .env.example .env || true; [ -f backend/pyproject.toml ] && (cd backend && uv venv && uv pip install -e ".[dev]"); [ -f auth/pyproject.toml ] && (cd auth && uv venv && uv pip install -e ".[dev]"); [ -f GIFTs/pyproject.toml ] && (cd GIFTs && uv venv && (uv pip install -e ".[dev]" || uv pip install -e .)); [ -f frontend/package.json ] && (cd frontend && npm ci || npm install)'
